name: earshot
description: Earshot, the macOS meeting recorder, for Claude Code: read your meetings through an MCP server and a skill, plus opt-in session reminders.

plugins.name: earshot
plugins.description: Search and read your Earshot meetings from Claude Code: notes, decisions, action items and transcripts.

plugins.name: earshot-reminders
plugins.description: Opt-in. At the start of each Claude Code session, adds up to five of your own open action items from the last week of Earshot meetings, quoted as data.
